title: FOR SOME %ELEMENT (SQL) | InterSystems SQL Reference | InterSystems IRIS Data Platform 2026.1

examples.sql: SELECT Name,FavoriteColors FROM Sample.Person WHERE FOR SOME %ELEMENT(FavoriteColors) (%VALUE='Red')
SELECT Name,FavoriteColors FROM Sample.Person WHERE FOR SOME %ELEMENT(FavoriteColors) (%KEY=2)
SELECT Name,FavoriteColors FROM Sample.Person WHERE FOR SOME %ELEMENT(FavoriteColors) (%VALUE IN ('Red','Blue'))
SELECT Name,FavoriteColors AS Preferences FROM Sample.Person WHERE FOR SOME %ELEMENT(FavoriteColors) AS fc (fc.%VALUE [ 'l' AND fc.%VALUE [ 'e')
